source: https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/apply/ (web form front-end read 2026-10-15: dates are DD.MM.YYYY from its date picker, name boxes 50, mother's and father's name 50, document number 20, address 100, email 100, phone digits after a country-code list), plus https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/info/what-do-i-need-for-my-e-visa-application/, https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/info/who-is-eligible-for-e-visa/, https://www.evisa.gov.tr/en/tour/thats/, https://www.evisa.gov.tr/assets/files/guide_en.pdf (group e-Visa guide, whose transfer file uses YYYYMMDD and its own limits), and https://www.mfa.gov.tr/visa-information-for-foreigners.en.mfa; re-checked 2026-07-14. The official flow first uses nationality, travel-document type, and arrival date to determine visa exemption, direct eligibility, conditional eligibility, or sticker-visa routing. The e-Visa flow can vary by nationality, so supporting-document fields are conditional and no local check can decide eligibility or price.

nationality.label: Nationality or region of travel document
nationality.help: Choose the nationality or region of the passport you will carry. The official system uses this answer to check exemption, eligibility, conditions, and price.

errors.invalidOption: Choose the nationality or region of your travel document

travel_document_type.label: Travel document type
travel_document_type.help: Choose the exact document type, usually Ordinary Passport. Diplomatic, service, special, official, and other documents can have different rules.

errors.invalidOption: Choose the exact type printed or assigned to your document

arrival_date.label: Arrival date in Türkiye
arrival_date.help: DD.MM.YYYY, as the e-Visa date picker writes it; the calendar starts at today. Enter the planned first arrival date. The e-Visa validity period begins from the date selected in the official application.

errors.tooEarly: Arrival date cannot be in the past

given_names.label: Given or first name(s)
given_names.help: Enter every given name as shown in the passport, up to 50 characters including spaces. The web form has a separate optional box for a second name, also 50.

errors.required: Given or first name is required
errors.tooShort: Enter the given name shown on the passport

surname.label: Surname(s)
surname.help: Enter the surname exactly as shown in the passport. Leave it blank only when the passport has no surname. Max 50 characters.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Match the passport date. DD.MM.YYYY, as the e-Visa date picker writes it; the calendar stops at today.

errors.tooLate: Date of birth cannot be later than today

place_of_birth.label: Place of birth
place_of_birth.help: Copy the place of birth from the passport. The official group guide sets a 40-character maximum including spaces.

errors.tooLong: Place of birth cannot exceed 40 characters

mothers_name.label: Mother's name
mothers_name.help: Enter all names when requested, up to 50 characters on the web form (the group guide's transfer file allows 40). The group guide allows this field to be blank when the mother's name is not indicated.

errors.invalidChars: Use Latin letters, spaces, hyphens, or apostrophes

fathers_name.label: Father's name
fathers_name.help: Enter all names when requested, up to 50 characters on the web form (the group guide's transfer file allows 40). The group guide allows this field to be blank when the father's name is not indicated.

errors.invalidChars: Use Latin letters, spaces, hyphens, or apostrophes

passport_number.label: Travel document number
passport_number.help: Copy the number exactly from the travel document selected earlier: letters and digits, no spaces or special characters. The web form takes up to 20 characters (the group guide's transfer file allows 16).

errors.tooShort: Enter the number printed on the travel document
errors.invalidChars: Use capital letters and numbers only, with no spaces
errors.invalidFormat: Use the letters and numbers printed as the document number

passport_issue_date.label: Travel document issue date
passport_issue_date.help: Match the issue date on the travel document. DD.MM.YYYY; the calendar stops at today.

errors.required: Travel document issue date is required
errors.tooLate: Issue date cannot be later than today

passport_expiry.label: Travel document expiry date
passport_expiry.help: DD.MM.YYYY. Match the document expiry date; the calendar starts at today. Türkiye generally requires validity at least 60 days beyond the permitted stay, and the official eligibility result can impose more.

errors.required: Travel document expiry date is required

email.label: Email
email.help: Use a lowercase email address you control. The payment link and e-Visa download link are sent by email. The web form takes up to 100 characters (the group guide's transfer file allows 40).

phone.label: Phone number
phone.help: Pick the country or region code from the list. The number box keeps digits only, up to the length of that country's numbers (15 at most).

errors.invalidFormat: Include the country code and 7-15 digits

home_address.label: Residence address
home_address.help: Enter the applicant's current residence address, up to 100 characters on the web form (the group guide's transfer file allows 200).

supporting_document_type.label: Supporting document type
supporting_document_type.help: Complete this only when the official eligibility result requires a valid visa or residence permit as support. An e-Visa is not available if you do not meet the stated condition.

errors.invalidOption: Choose visa or residence permit only when the official result requires it

supporting_document_issuer.label: Supporting document issuing country or area
supporting_document_issuer.help: Select the country or area that issued the supporting visa or residence permit. Current MFA country rules commonly refer to Schengen, the United States, the United Kingdom, or Ireland, but follow the exact eligibility screen.

errors.invalidOption: Choose the issuer shown on the supporting document

supporting_document_expiry.label: Supporting document expiry date
supporting_document_expiry.help: DD.MM.YYYY. Enter the expiry date when the supporting document has one. It must remain valid under the conditions shown by the official e-Visa system.
